<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Get a receipt"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/receipts/{receiptId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the receipt with its lines, state, version (also as the `ETag`)
and the discrepancies as they stand now (final once the receipt is
`Closed`). `cartonDiscrepancies` lists every carton finding raised on
the receipt so far, scans and the close alike, in the order they were
raised (ADR 0015); it is `[]` when there are none.

  as={"h2"}
